conventions.units: L/s; neck velocity m/s on nominal neck area unless velocity was published (then the published value); pressure Pa (total unless pressure_kind says static)
conventions.noise: NC25/NC30 and NR25/NR30 are where the published table reaches that rating (linear interpolation). NR is roughly 2-5 points stricter than NC for the same diffuser. US makers rate NC with 10 dB room absorption; Holyoake/Airfoil/Advantage Air use 8 dB; Trox gives sound power LWA. Ratings below the table floor ('-' or '<15') are treated as the floor value (conservative).
conventions.bound: bound='lower' means the outlet was still quieter than the target at the last tabulated row; the ls given is the last row, i.e. a lower bound.
conventions.primary: primary=false marks a variant (e.g. cone 20% open, branch-duct rule) that should not enter a plain average.
conventions.linear_slot: ls for linear_slot is L/s per metre per slot.

sources.title: Section D Diffusers - CRA Ceiling Round Adjustable, performance data
sources.basis: airflow at NC25/NC30 (8 dB room absorption re 1e-12 W), cones down, no damper
sources.notes: Nominal duct 200-400 mm; neck velocities as published (they imply a ~186 mm actual neck for the 200). Plaque version CRP (p.84D) is ~3-5 NC louder at the same flow; not counted separately. Dampering adds noise (their p.12A).

sources.title: Round Ceiling Diffusers (fixed, aluminium multi-cone) data sheet - selection table
sources.basis: airflow at NR25/NR30 (room correction not stated)
sources.notes: UK arm of the Polyaire group. 150 mm row prints '378' for NR at 60 L/s (typo, read as 37). No 350 mm row. Low capacities vs US NC tables: NR is stricter than NC and the room basis is unstated.

sources.title: Accessories Catalogue Aug 2026 (PCIAAU0726), Appendix - Round Diffusers RND/IRND
sources.basis: airflow at NC25/NC30 (10 dB room absorption), centre cone 100% open; 20% open rows kept as a variant
sources.notes: Residential plastic round outlets RND6/8/10/12 = 150/200/250/300 neck. Catalogue says data 'extrapolated from tests on a sample set'. Fully open they barely reach NC25 inside the table for 250/300 (lower bounds). At 20% open (a balanced outlet) NC25 comes at roughly 60% of the open-cone airflow and the pressure drop is ~60-80 Pa.

sources.title: Plastic Diffusers and Grilles - Sunline Diffusers performance data (C-SUN2)
sources.basis: airflow at NR25/NR30 read from the published NR-vs-airflow curve (room basis not stated)
sources.notes: Residential ABS round outlet (200/250/300). Values read off a chart (+/-5%). Implies very high neck velocities (4-6 m/s) and 50-70 Pa at NR25; old (2002) rating.

sources.title: RCD Round Cone Diffuser performance data (four cone, horizontal)
sources.basis: airflow at NC25/NC30 (10 dB room absorption, one diffuser), ASHRAE 70-2023
sources.notes: Imperial necks 6/8/10/12/14/16 in = 152/203/254/305/356/406 mm. US NC ratings use 10 dB room attenuation, so they read quieter than NR or 8 dB data at the same airflow.

sources.title: TMR / TMR-AA round ceiling diffuser performance data (2017 catalogue)
sources.basis: airflow at NC25/NC30, cones in position 2 (cones down, as shipped); 10 dB room absorption, ASHRAE 70
sources.notes: Position 1 is ~4-6 NC quieter at the same airflow.

sources.title: RM1/5RM1 round three-cone diffuser, IP/metric performance data (no damper)
sources.basis: airflow at NC25/NC30, position 2 (more induction); 10 dB room absorption, ASHRAE 70 / ISO 5219
sources.notes: Metric columns as published. Position 1 (max capacity) is ~5-7 NC quieter.

sources.title: ADLR circular ceiling diffuser, quick sizing ADLR-A/AR supply (PD-ADLR 02/2017)
sources.basis: airflow at sound POWER LWA 35 dB(A) (treated as ~NR25) and LWA 30 dB(A); not a room NR/NC
sources.notes: Nominal sizes 1-5 have spigot ØD 137/193/249/305/361 mm. LWA->NR assumes ~4-8 dB room attenuation and NR ~ LpA-6; treat as indicative only.

sources.title: 2023 ASHRAE Handbook - HVAC Applications, Ch.49 Noise and Vibration Control, Table 9: Maximum recommended air velocities at neck of supply diffusers or return registers
sources.basis: neck ('free opening') velocity rule: RC(N)25 = 350 fpm (1.78 m/s), RC(N)30 = 425 fpm (2.16 m/s); L/s derived = velocity x nominal neck area
sources.notes: For use when no manufacturer sound data exists; handbook says reduce further where several outlets serve one room. Return openings: 425/500 fpm. Values below are derived, not tabulated.

sources.title: Installation Best Practice Guidelines - Ducted Type Systems (DB0817 v1.7), Outlets
sources.basis: maximum recommended airflow per flexible duct (outlet branch) diameter; noise-minimising guidance, no NC stated
sources.notes: Column headings in the PDF are swapped; values pair diameter->max L/s. Implied velocities 2.5 m/s (150) rising to 4 m/s (350-400). Companion doc 0520-026 (2021) caps the final duct to an outlet at 3 m/s for variable-airflow systems and says to use the outlet maker's data.

sources.title: Airflow Application Guidelines, split ducted (Doc 0520-026 v1)
sources.basis: final duct to outlet max 3 m/s (derived L/s = 3 m/s x duct area)
sources.notes: Stated 'to minimize noise generation at supply air outlet'; branch 4-6 m/s, main 6-7 m/s. Derived values.

sources.title: Manual D Table 3-1 recommended velocities (reproduced in AHRI 'Manual D calculation' sheet)
sources.basis: flex supply branch recommended 600 fpm (3.05 m/s), max 700 fpm; supply outlet face velocity 'size for throw', max 700 fpm (3.56 m/s)
sources.notes: Branch-duct velocity, not an outlet noise rating; derived L/s per round branch at 600 fpm. Return grille 500 fpm, filter grille 300 fpm.

sources.title: Section D Diffusers - CMP Ceiling Multi Pattern (4-way louvred, square neck)
sources.basis: airflow at NC25/NC30 (8 dB room attenuation, steel diffuser); aluminium = listed NC +3
sources.notes: Square neck 150-450. Recommended max per side vs ceiling height also given (p.147D): 2.4 m ceiling 0.095 m3/s per side.

sources.title: Square Ceiling Diffusers LFD (4-way louvre face) - selection data
sources.basis: airflow at NR25/NR30, 4-way throw (3-way x0.75, 2-way x0.5)
sources.notes: Opposed-blade damper adds +1 NR fully open, +5-6 NR at 50% closed. '<22' rows treated as NR22 (conservative). Archived page; current Polyaire site has no data.

sources.title: Plaque Ceiling Diffuser PCD - performance data (tested by Louis A. Challis & Associates)
sources.basis: airflow at NR25/NR30 (NC also listed, ~1 lower)
sources.notes: Square plaque, square neck. Throw for plaque range to be reduced 50% (their note).

sources.title: Accessories Catalogue Aug 2026, Appendix - Bevelled Edge Diffusers (square 4-way)
sources.basis: airflow at NC25/NC30 (2.7 m ceiling, isothermal); NC basis not stated on this table (round table on same page says 10 dB)
sources.notes: Residential plastic 4-way. Plenum/cushion box adds +2 NC at 1-2 m/s spigot, +3 at 2.5, +4 at 3, +6 at 3.5, +8 at 4 m/s (their adder table). 450x450 stays <NC15 to 350 L/s (lower bound).

sources.title: Plastic Diffusers and Grilles - Silhouette diffusers performance chart (C-ST2)
sources.basis: airflow at NC20/NC30 read from log-log chart (8 dB room absorption); NC25 interpolated
sources.notes: Residential plastic square 4-way; 280x280 (core 0.078 m2) and 360x360 tee-bar (core 0.130 m2). Chart-read (+/-8%).

sources.title: TMS square ceiling diffuser, round neck, high performance (2017)
sources.basis: airflow at NC25/NC30, 24x24 in module (10 dB room absorption)
sources.notes: Round neck in square face; 12x12 module rows (6/8 in necks) are ~1-3 NC louder.

sources.title: SCD Square Cone Diffuser performance data, 24x24 in face
sources.basis: airflow at NC25/NC30 (10 dB room absorption, one diffuser), ASHRAE 70-2023
sources.notes: Round neck, square face.

sources.publisher: Quality Air Equipment (QAE); same table reprinted in Daikin AU accessories catalogue 2026 p.58
sources.title: Stocked Range Grilles - Floor Grilles FG/HDFG performance data
sources.basis: airflow at NC25/NC30 (basis not stated; Daikin reprint of sister tables says 10 dB)
sources.notes: Extruded aluminium fixed-bar floor grille, 0 deg, no damper. 'Face velocity' in the table is on effective area (~0.6 of nominal neck); neck_velocity_ms below is on nominal neck. Daikin's floor-grille table is the same data, so count once.

sources.title: Floor Grilles (BGF) performance data, 15 deg kick blades
sources.basis: airflow at NR25/NR30 for the given grille length: table is L/s per metre at NR for 3 m active length, corrected by their length table (0.3 m -9 NR, 0.6 m -7, 1.2 m -4)
sources.notes: Aluminium linear bar floor grille (8 dB room absorption). Short residential grilles are much quieter per metre than the 3 m table, so the length correction matters. 0 deg blades are 5-8 NR quieter at the same flow.

sources.title: Air Handling Reference Catalogue - 1.3 Slimline Floor Grille ASGF, sound selection chart
sources.basis: airflow at NR25/NR30 read from the per-metre NR bar chart, length-corrected (their table: 0.5 m -3, 1 m 0, 1.5 m +2 -> ~10log10 L)
sources.notes: Chart is per 1 m length, 'max recommended at dT 4 C'. Chart-read on a log axis (+/-10%).

sources.title: Grilles, Registers & Diffusers - Residential (HC-GRD-RES CT-001E 09-23): 420/421 floor diffuser engineering data + recommended face velocities
sources.basis: H&C recommended face velocity for residences 500-750 fpm (on Ak); value at 500 fpm recorded as the quiet end, 750 fpm as the upper end
sources.notes: No NC tabulated for these floor registers; H&C says use the face-velocity guideline. Their general supply guidance is 500-800 fpm with 700 typical. Inch sizes: 4x10 ~ 250x100, 4x12 ~ 300x100, 4x14 ~ 350x100, 6x10 ~ 250x150, 6x12 ~ 300x150, 6x14 ~ 350x150.

sources.title: Product Catalogue Edition 1 - Grilles: floor grilles, floor boots
sources.basis: qualitative: 350x150 for air conditioning / dual systems; 300x100 'mainly gas heating only due to lower airflow'. Boots: 300x100 fed by 150 or 200 spigot, 300x150 by 200/250, 350x150 by 250
sources.notes: No airflow table. Implied capacity = the spigot that feeds it (see ActronAir per-duct maxima: 150=44, 200=92, 250=170 L/s). Same guidance repeated by Eventus and other AU resellers.

sources.title: Accessories Catalogue Aug 2026, Appendix - Removable Core Double Deflection Register
sources.basis: airflow at NC25/NC30, blades 0 deg, no damper (NC basis not stated on page)
sources.notes: Sidewall within 600 mm of ceiling. 40 deg blade pitch adds ~50% pressure.

sources.title: Section E Supply/Return Grilles - DDL/DDS-20 double deflection, performance data
sources.basis: airflow at NC25/NC30, 0 deg deflection; velocities are on effective core area Ac
sources.notes: Rows list equivalent sizes (e.g. 305x100 = 240x125 = 195x150). Matched to nearest AU size.

sources.title: Linear Slot Diffusers LSD - selection data (one-way and two-way blow)
sources.basis: L/s per metre at the first row reaching 'NC 25' / 'NC 30' (table steps are coarse; '<25' below)
sources.notes: Imperial-derived steps (15.5 L/s/m = 10 cfm/ft). Slot width not stated (product drawings ~20-22 mm).

sources.title: Linear Slot Diffuser LSD - performance data, 25 mm and 20 mm slots, supply
sources.basis: L/s per metre at NR25/NR30 (room basis and active length not stated on sheet)
sources.notes: Values per slot = table L/s/m / number of slots.

sources.title: Accessories Catalogue Aug 2026, Appendix - Removable Core Linear Slot Diffuser RCLS (2-slot)
sources.basis: airflow per module at NC25/NC30, one-way blow, 2.7 m ceiling; converted to L/s per m per slot
sources.notes: RCLS600 = 0.6 m, RCLS1200 = 1.2 m, both 2 slots (catalogue p.27). RCLS900 NC row missing in source.

sources.title: SDS Linear Slot Diffuser performance data - metric, pressurised plenum (SDS50 12.7 mm, SDS75 19 mm)
sources.basis: L/s per m at NC25/NC30 for a 3 m active length (10 dB); per-slot = /slots
sources.notes: Length correction: 1.2 m active is 6 NC quieter, 0.6 m 11 NC quieter, so short residential slots carry ~25-35% more per metre at the same NC. ASHRAE 70-2006.
